title: Illustration / Characters / Hair
slide_intent: Reduce a hairstyle to large coherent forms so it stays recognizable when the character changes view.
strategic_value: Simple but distinctive hair shapes can help Duolingo preserve variety while making illustration and animation easier to manage.
demonstration: Four rows pair a finished hairstyle with a translucent geometric breakdown, connected by arrows, with explanatory copy at right.
practical_value: Look for one or two large shapes that preserve the hairstyle’s character before adding irregular details.

content_islands.name: Hairstyle breakdowns
content_islands.spec: Stack four finished heads at left, each followed by an arrow and a blue construction view showing the principal hair shapes.

content_islands.name: Simplicity rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the Hair heading and explanation at right, connecting excess irregular shapes with difficulty turning the head.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that too many irregular shapes make hair complex and hard to turn in space.
reference_purposes.Expression: The examples retain distinct hairstyles despite simple construction.
reference_purposes.Application: Arrows connect finished heads to geometric breakdowns.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The guidance prefers one or two large hair shapes where possible, rather than an absolute shape-count limit.

ingredient.name: Large-shape hair construction
ingredient.role: Keep a distinctive hairstyle manageable across views.
ingredient.application: When possible, compose hair from one or two large shapes and avoid unnecessary irregular pieces.
ingredient.scope: Historical official Duolingo illustration guidance from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot. The one-or-two preference is explicitly conditional, not a prohibition on every more complex hairstyle.
